title: Works Within the Captive Body
description: The Lord's structural operations in the deeper descent. T32 — seven works of the Living Spirit in forming the cosmos: pearl drawn from sea, soul stretched through every body, substances of death fixed in place, doctrinal vessels established, rational sent out, watches stationed, glorious image of the Ambassador sent forth. T33 — five supports the operative power has set within the self's body: bearing-disc, Pillar of Glory, molding of Gehennas, pillars in the great sea, four walls around strongholds. T34 — further constructive works: building the aeon anew, filling the heights with vessels, the wheels turning, gates opened and shut. T35 — the four works of the Ambassador's revealing: image shown forth, gates of firmaments opened and shut, chosen-out super-light, indwelling perfection in the elect.
